competing_explanation: The 30-day window may be outdated, misremembered, or specific to a prior policy or non-standard items.
hypothesis_statement: The current full-refund return window for standard items is 30 days.
refutation_criterion: Authoritative current policy evidence shows the full-refund window for standard items is not 30 days, or that 30 days applies only to a different category or condition.
